translation: Kwaye ngoku nithi niya kuzimela umbuso kaYahwe, olu sezandleni zonyana kaDawidi; kananjalo nini nimbalwa, nini namaninzi, kwaye nani nazo iintombi zengigidi zesigebenga, ngesiHebhere עגלי זהב, ukuze nibe ngoothixo — ndilungise: kwaye nani nazo amakhaka esigebenga lesilivere, azenziweyo nguYerobhawukanye nina ukuba nibe ngoothixo. — isiphumo esichanekileyo: Kwaye ngoku nithi niya kuzimela umbuso kaYahwe, olu sezandleni zonyana kaDawidi; kananjalo nini namaninzi abantu, kwaye nani neenkonyana zengigidi ezenza nibe ngoothixo, azenza ngoonina uYerobhawu ukuba nibe ngoothixo. — okokugqibela: Kwaye ngoku nithi ukuze nizimele ukuchasene kombuso kaYahwe, olusezandleni zonyana kaDawidi, nini namanyala amaninzi, kwaye nani neenkonyana zengigidi ngesigebenga, ukuze kube ngoothixo kuni, lowo wazenzela kuni uYerobhawu ukuba nibe ngoothixo. — iimpazamo zombhalo ongaphezulu; candelo olusemthethweni: Kwaye ngoku nithi ukuba nizimela umbuso kaYahwe, olu usezandleni zonyana kaDawidi, nini ngenani elikhulu, nani namakhaka engigidi yesigebenga lowo wakha wona uYerobhawu ukuba ngamathixo kuni — impendulo ekugqibeleni: “Kwaye ngoku nithi niya kuzimela umbuso kaYahwe, olu sezandleni zonyana kaDawidi; kananjalo nini namaninzi, kwaye nani namakhaka engigidi yesiHebhere עגלי זהב, awenziwa nguYerobhawu ukuba nibe ngoothixo.”
